prompt: Elements `[60, 55, 45, 35, 25, 15, 5]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[60, 55, 45, 35, 25, 15, 5]` to `[5, 25, 15, 35, 55, 60, 45]`.
